description: Have the line call a real number and hold a live voice conversation on the owner's behalf. Brief it like a human assistant: who to ask for, what you want, acceptable fallbacks, what to do on voicemail. Set connect_owner when the owner wants to be put through once a human is reached (the line waits on hold, then rings the owner). Asynchronous: poll get_call or wait for the call.completed webhook.

connect_owner.description: Hold-and-bridge. The line works the phone menu and waits on hold; when a person who can help is on the line it says 'one moment' and rings the owner's mobile, joining the two. The line drops off. Use when the owner wants to talk themselves but not wait. Needs owner_phone on the line.

max_minutes.description: No call runs longer than 10 minutes.

purpose.description: The job in plain English, with fallbacks and what to do on voicemail. Up to 1,200 characters; a longer purpose is refused with an error, never trimmed.

name: place_call
title: Place a phone call
